heard: This is the family history of Esau that is Eden-Edom He took his wives from the daughters of Canaan Adah, daughter of Elam and oh, Alabama And Basemath, daughter of Ishmael God abhorred Eliphaz to Esau in the land And Basemath bore Rehwil, sons born in Canaan While Abamah bore Jish, Jelum, and Korah Their possessions were too great for them to live together The land where they were staying Could not support them Because of their lifestyle They had to move away
